services: Storm, wind, and hail damage repair — help with insurance claims
Full roof replacement (free inspection and estimate)
Tile, shingle, and flat/foam roofs; roof maintenance and coatings
emergency_triggers: Water actively coming into the house — through the ceiling, around lights, down walls
A section of roof missing, collapsed, or open to the sky after a storm
A tree or debris through the roof
Ceiling sagging or bulging with water
safety_line: - If a ceiling is sagging with water or there's water near electrical fixtures: tell them to keep everyone out of that room, put a bucket down, and switch off power to that area at the breaker if it's safe to do so. Then continue.
triage_questions: - What are they seeing — an active leak, storm damage, missing tiles or shingles, or are they looking at a replacement?
- Is water coming in right now? (Urgent if yes.)
- What kind of roof — tile, shingle, flat/foam — and roughly how old, if they know?
- Is this going through insurance, or do they plan to pay directly? (Just note it — don't advise on claims.)
faq: - Inspections and estimates: free, unless {{owner_name}} has said otherwise — {{pricing_or_owner}}
- Do you work with insurance? Yes — {{owner_name}} can walk them through it at the inspection.
- How soon can you come out? Offer the earliest open time from checkAvailability.
callback_promise: within one business day — sooner if it's leaking
